definitions.scannedFiles: all eligible text files (NUL-free), including empty and gitignored-tracked files
definitions.matchedFiles: valid-UTF-8 files with at least one finding
definitions.matchedLines: lines with at least one finding
definitions.findingsCount: finding records; one per matched line (equals matchedLines)
definitions.findingsDigest: sha256 of sorted finding identities joined by newline
definitions.normalizedLine: line text with one trailing newline and one trailing carriage return removed
definitions.binary: eligible path whose bytes contain a NUL byte; counted in binarySkipped
definitions.invalidUtf8: text file that is not valid UTF-8; findings unknown, run exits 2
